objective: Provide a project-scoped data-migration asset domain for immutable files, directories, metadata collaboration, approval, controlled external sharing and a permanent recycle bin.

requirements.statement: Create immutable-content assets with system UUIDs and server-derived file metadata after attachment scanning succeeds.
acceptance: File number is a generated UUID
Name, size, type, MD5, SHA-256, uploader and upload time come from trusted attachment/authentication data
Binary replacement is impossible through metadata update APIs
requirements.source: Original user request and confirmed immutable-content decision
counterexample: Accepting uploader identity or hash values from the browser
Replacing content while retaining a file UUID

requirements.statement: Query assets by project, UUID, name, directory, tag, review state, uploader and time with project scope and server pagination.
acceptance: A 100,000-file project first page meets p95 at or below 800ms in the controlled benchmark
Cross-project and cross-tenant records are not returned
requirements.source: Original query requirement and confirmed scale
counterexample: Loading all project files into browser memory

requirements.statement: Support project directories, controlled tags, append-only remarks, per-user favorites and batch operations with explicit partial results.
acceptance: Directory cycles and duplicate sibling names are rejected
Batch tag, remark and favorite actions report per-item failures
requirements.source: Original user request and confirmed collaboration decisions
counterexample: Overwriting a single shared remark field

requirements.statement: Use explicit workflow approval and freeze metadata while review is pending while keeping every review state visible to project members.
acceptance: Draft can be submitted and withdrawn
Approval and rejection history is visible and audited
counterexample: Changing tags or directory during pending review

requirements.statement: Provide revocable, password-protected external links with a seven-day maximum, access limits and separate preview/download grants.
acceptance: Only token hashes and BCrypt password hashes are stored
Archive, recycle, quarantine or explicit revoke invalidates access
Attempts and successful accesses are rate-limited and audited
counterexample: A share bypasses scan or asset state checks

requirements.statement: Move deleted assets into a permanent recycle bin with controlled restore and physical purge.
acceptance: Delete revokes shares and preserves recoverable metadata
Purge removes content and business relations but keeps immutable audit
counterexample: Physical deletion on the normal delete action

invariants: Platform RBAC, project role and asset state must all allow an operation
Project and attachment private tables are not read directly
Recycle and quarantine invalidate all shares
constraints: Depends on approved project, attachment and workflow contracts

selected_approach.name: Dedicated ccb-data-migration business module consuming platform contracts
selected_approach.reason: Asset collaboration and lifecycle are data-migration business rules, while project, object and workflow ownership stay reusable and independent.

alternatives.name: Put all rules in ccb-attachment
alternatives.rejected_because: Business directories, tags and reviews would pollute the platform layer.

alternatives.name: Implement project and storage privately
alternatives.rejected_because: It duplicates authoritative data and security-critical infrastructure.

components.name: Asset application service
components.responsibility: Coordinate asset lifecycle and project/attachment checks

components.name: Review gateway
components.responsibility: Submit and reconcile workflow approval without reading workflow tables

components.name: Share gateway
components.responsibility: Issue and validate strongly constrained external grants

interfaces.name: Asset REST API
interfaces.contract: Scoped query, metadata, directory, collaboration, review and recycle operations

interfaces.name: External share API
interfaces.contract: Token and password protected preview/download with atomic limits

error_handling.condition: Metadata version conflict or pending review
error_handling.behavior: Return conflict and preserve stored state
error_handling.recovery: Reload or withdraw review before editing

error_handling.behavior: Return success/failure counts and per-item errors
Rate-limit and temporarily lock the token
error_handling.recovery: Wait for the lock period or revoke and issue a new share

error_handling.condition: Physical purge cannot delete the object
error_handling.behavior: Retain a retryable purge state and deny content access
error_handling.recovery: Compensation retries while audit remains intact

compatibility: Does not alter temporary preview behavior

verification_strategy.signal: Trusted asset metadata, scoped query results and benchmark latency
verification_strategy.method: API integration, permission and controlled dataset performance tests
Domain, concurrency and workflow contract tests
Expiry, password, rate-limit, concurrent-count and state-invalidation security tests

verification_strategy.signal: Recycle, restore and purge state plus audit

assumptions.text: Project members may see all review states
assumptions.falsifier: A later approved privacy requirement restricts draft visibility

unknowns.question: Which workflow code and reviewer-selection policy will the Owner approve for asset review?
unknowns.impact: Must be fixed in the task scope before implementation

decisions.decision: Keep file content immutable and create a new UUID for changed content
decisions.reason: Maintains audit integrity without a version subsystem

decisions.decision: Keep recycle-bin entries permanently until explicit purge

decisions.reason: The same bytes can be a valid independent asset in another directory

risks.risk: Anonymous sharing becomes an authorization bypass
risks.mitigation: Short validity, mandatory password, explicit grants, atomic limits, rate limiting, revocation and audit

risks.risk: Permanent recycle bin creates unbounded storage
risks.mitigation: Visible quotas, administrative purge permission and capacity monitoring without automatic deletion

approval.evidence: User confirmed all seven design sections and selected the dedicated-module approach.
